status.summary: Welterweight contender, ranked #2 by the UFC media panel and #1 in the Meta UFC Rankings. Pro record 24-7 (ESPN, Wikipedia, Yahoo), UFC 7-1 with all seven wins by KO/TKO. He stopped Jack Della Maddalena in the UFC Perth main event (May 2, 2026; TKO R3 3:17) after knocking out Leon Edwards at UFC 322 (Nov 15, 2025). He was promised a title shot and agreed to face champion Islam Makhachev in January, but on Oct 20, 2026 the UFC told his manager Makhachev would not be ready, without giving a reason (MMA Fighting, Nov 5, 2026). He is now officially booked against Michael Morales for the interim UFC welterweight title in the co-main event of UFC 336 (Jan 30, 2027, Scotiabank Arena, Toronto), announced during the UFC 333 broadcast; Joshua Van vs Manel Kape headlines. Injuries: he said he went into the Della Maddalena fight with a partial ligament tear in his right shoulder (Sherdog, May 18, 2026), and Bloody Elbow headlines from May 2026 report a leg injury from the Perth fight and daily pain from a long career (those pages returned 403 and were not read). Age 33.
status.ranking: #2 welterweight (UFC media panel, Nov 3-5, 2026); #1 in the Meta UFC Rankings (Oct 31, 2026). Read from ufcrankings.org and ufcalendar.com mirrors because ufc.com returned 403. Not in the men's pound-for-pound top 15.

injuries.what: Partial tear of a ligament in the right shoulder going into the Della Maddalena fight; he said he could not raise the arm above his head (his own account on the Podpah podcast).

Leg injury in the UFC Perth win; reportedly wheeled to the hotel lobby in a shopping cart. Headline and search snippet only (page returned 403); severity not known, and he was later booked for Jan 2027.

Says roughly 140 Muay Thai and MMA fights leave him with daily pain ('I cannot even walk well'); plans to fight until about 35. Headline and snippet only (403); the age-35 plan matches the Sherdog interview.

style.summary: A tall, very long-armed (78 in reach) switch-stance Muay Thai striker with rare stopping power: seven UFC wins, seven stoppages, and 2.3 knockdowns per 15 minutes. He fights almost entirely at range with straight punches, hooks, kicks and knees, and finishes with spinning and ground elbows. He is hittable and takes leg kicks. His one UFC loss was a decision to a rangy, busy striker who out-landed him over five rounds.

moves.notes: Target split from the fighters.json S sums: decayed significant attempts go 74.8% head, 12.2% body, 13.0% legs, and landed strikes 62.9% head, 16.5% body, 20.7% legs. Career attempts are 72.1/13.7/14.2. Body attempts are at the welterweight rate (13.9%), and his body finishes were a knee (Radtke) and ground elbows (Della Maddalena), so body kicks and knees take most of the body weight and body punches stay small. Leg attempts are 1.4x the division rate (9.3%), so calf and inside kicks get 0.5 together. ufcstats does not split calf from inside kicks. 89% of his decayed landed strikes come at distance and about 1% in the clinch, so the knee weight (0.25) is mainly distance knees, and elbow (0.15) covers the spinning back elbow and ground elbows. Spinning is 0.12 because one of his seven KOs was a spinning back elbow. The head punches favour the cross and hook, which scored four punch KOs, but ufcstats does not record which punch landed, so that split is a judgment. No outside scouting source could be fetched this pass.
